seo.title: English Cocker Spaniel Breeder in Tuscany, Italy | Allevamento Cocker Montecorno
seo.description: Meet Allevamento Cocker Montecorno in Grosseto, Tuscany. Natascia has raised English Cocker Spaniels since 2005. Recognised by ENCI and FCI since 2010.

homeIntroTitle:
A family breeding home,
recognised by ENCI and FCI.
homeIntro: We have bred English Cocker Spaniels in Grosseto, Tuscany, since 2005. We plan only a few litters a year, so each dog and each family receives the time they need. Natascia runs the breeding home personally, with the help of her family.
worldNote: Our dogs, puppies, story and photographs.

homePuppyText: Puppies grow up with us until they join their new families, whom we always meet before a placement. Here you will find dates and colours of our litters.
